_what: The named spot fixes image-edit handles. Each is ONE delta with slots, the extra keeps it adds to the kind's split, what the caller must supply, which brand file rides along as a reference, and the test the two-picture judge adds. A fix is a delta template, never a description of the picture.
_curator: Damon. Status per row: draft / approved / deprecated. A changed fix is a NEW file -v<N+1>-damon.json beside this one; highest wins.

fixes.name: Wrong logo
fixes.what: the logo in the picture is the wrong one, or a made-up one — swap it for the brand's real mark, in the same place at the same size
fixes.delta: replace the logo with the attached brand logo, same position, same size, same orientation
keep: everything around the logo, to the pixel
checks: The logo now matches the attached brand mark exactly — same letterforms, same proportions — and sits where the old one sat.

fixes.name: Wrong words
fixes.what: one line of type says the wrong thing, or is garbled. PARKED 2026-09-22: a model cannot be trusted to re-letter type. Four live attempts on one line: twice it redrew the product's own label, once it re-composed the frame, once it painted the masked band black. This agrees with the standing doctrine — type is composited over a clean plate, never generated. The route for wrong words is the COMPOSITOR: change the words in the brief's type layer and recompose (tools/image-production/tools/compose.py), which is exact and free.
fixes.delta: re-letter the text that reads "{was}" so it reads "{now}" — same typeface, same size, same colour, same position
keep: every other word in the picture
checks: The text now reads exactly "{now}", legibly, in the same typeface, size, colour and position as before. No other word in the picture changed.
fixes.region_hint: the line of type being re-lettered

fixes.name: Wrong product
fixes.what: the product is drawn wrong, or is the wrong one — swap it for the brand's real product from the attached photo, at the same angle and size, in the same hand or spot
fixes.delta: replace the product with the attached product photo, at the same angle, the same size, in the same position
keep: the hand or surface holding it
checks: The product now matches the attached product photo — its shape, colour, cap and label — at the same angle and size, in the same position.

fixes.name: Move one element
fixes.what: one element sits in the wrong place — move it, and only it
keep: every other element exactly where it is
checks: {element} is now {where}, and nothing else in the picture has moved.
fixes.region_hint: the element being moved, plus where it lands

fixes.name: Swap the background
fixes.what: the subject, the product and the type are right; the background is wrong — swap it, keeping every foreground element exactly where it is
fixes.delta: replace the background with {background}, keeping every foreground element exactly where it is
keep: the subject, the product and the type, to the pixel
checks: The background is now {background}. The subject, product and type are unchanged in shape, position and size.

fixes.name: Remove one thing
fixes.what: something is in the picture that should not be — a bystander, a watermark, a stray object — remove it and fill the space with what is behind it
fixes.delta: remove {thing} and fill the space with what is behind it
checks: {thing} is gone and the space reads as the background continuing. Nothing else changed.

_region: A fix may carry `region` — left,top,right,bottom as percentages — and then NOTHING outside that rectangle can differ: the original is put back over it, pixel for pixel. Ruled 2026-09-22 after three live fixes were held because the model redrew the product's own label text every roll. `region_hint` says what the rectangle should cover for that row.
_parked: A row marked `parked` is not run. It stays here with what was measured, so nobody rediscovers it. `text` is parked because type belongs to the compositor.
